newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks surge on foreign buying of blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks surge on foreign buying of blue chips.

text.p: Tokyo stocks surged in early morning trade on Thursday on robust buying by foreign investors attracted by export-orientated blue chips, brokers said.
At 0042 GMT, the Nikkei 225 was up 331.21 points, or 1.80 percent, at 18,741.17.
The index surged more than two percent soon after the opening.
Foreign investors showed a net buying stance of 1.5 million shares in orders placed via Japan"s "Big Four" brokerages before the opening.
The said foreigners placed 8.5 million shares of sell orders against 10 million of buys.
Brokers said the surge in New York stocks overnight encouraged foreign buyers, who continued to pick up international blue chips, such as Sony Corp.
Brokers said participants were also buying back bank shares, which have lost ground in recent weeks due to concerns about the financial health of parts of the sector.
